findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The minimum password length is 6 characters, set both on the server and in the client forms.

findings.fsdQuote: When Prompt on Download is on, Kavita asks for confirmation before any download larger than 500 MB.
findings.note: The download confirmation threshold is 100 MB (SIZE_WARNING = 104,857,600 bytes), not 500 MB.

findings.fsdQuote: Days of Backups and Days of Logs each accept a value from 1 to 30 and both default to 30.
findings.note: Backups and logs are validated to a range of 1 to 30. I did not check the default of 30.

findings.fsdQuote: Cache Size must be at least 50 MB
findings.note: Cache size has a minimum of 50.
